local_context.summary: Stable returned provisionally_complete for an explicitly closed and exhaustive supplied corpus even though every publication mapped to one resolved trial and the inventory stated that no other trial was represented.
local_context.corrective_route: classify audited_complete only when supplied evidence explicitly closes the requested universe and leaves no missing source, candidate, or eligibility decision; otherwise retain a provisional or open status

content.required_guard: do not overclaim completeness when a source or eligibility decision is missing

fixtures.research_scope: Create one result row per unique randomized salt-substitution trial represented in the supplied corpus, and report whether this supplied corpus is sufficient to enumerate that trial set.

source_documents.title: Salt-substitution corpus inventory
source_documents.text: This closed corpus contains every publication in the collection: one protocol, one primary outcomes article, and one renal outcomes article. All three records carry registration ChiCTR-TRC-12002212; no other randomized trial or unresolved candidate is represented in this corpus.

source_documents.title: Trial identity crosswalk
source_documents.text: The protocol, primary report, and renal analysis all concern the Salt Substitute and Stroke Study (SSaSS), ChiCTR-TRC-12002212. The renal article reused the same randomized cohort and did not recruit a separate trial.

fixtures.research_scope: Create one result row per eligible randomized workplace-break trial established by the supplied corpus, and report the completeness of the requested trial universe.

source_documents.title: Workplace-break evidence index
source_documents.text: The available index confirms Aster WorkBreak 2014 as eligible. Two later candidate reports appear only in Supplement S9, which is missing from the supplied corpus, and no eligibility decision for those reports is available.
